package.name: qrb_ros_adapter
package.description:
ROS IPC Bridge of qrb_ros_adapter: a persistent Manager dynamically creates one typed ROS 2 node per registered HCM Flow in a shared process. Contract definitions are provided by qrb_contracts; DMA-BUF payloads travel as SCM_RIGHTS file descriptors.
Typed factories and qrb_ros_transport TypeAdapters support inline and DMA-BUF message paths without message-specific node subclasses.
